verdict.rationale: Mercury documents international/domestic wire transfers and no-fee USD payments abroad (mercury-docs-7, mercury-docs-46, mercury-docs-53), but nothing in the evidence pack claims or demonstrates sub-minute arrival times for cross-border transfers — wires/ACH are the described rails, not instant settlement.
